teaser.en: A climbing relative of the monkey oranges, from the same genus that gives strychnine.
teaser.sw: Jamaa anayepanda wa mikwakwa (monkey oranges), kutoka jenasi ile ile inayotoa sumu ya strychnine.
teaser.dg: Mmea unaokpwera, ndugu wa mihi ya *monkey orange*, wa jenasi ihi ihi inayolavya sumu ya *strychnine*.

summary.en: *Chikwakwa* is a climbing *Strychnos* of the coastal forests, related to the monkey oranges. Pakia records the name but no uses.
summary.sw: *Chikwakwa* ni *Strychnos* inayopanda ya misitu ya pwani, jamaa wa mikwakwa. Pakia ameandika jina lake lakini si matumizi yoyote.
summary.dg: *Chikwakwa* ni mmea wa jenasi ya *Strychnos* unaokpwera, wa matsaka ga pwani, ndugu wa mihi ya *monkey orange*. Pakia anaandika dzinare, ela kaandika matumizige.

about.en: *Strychnos panganensis* is a woody climber or scrambling shrub of the genus that includes the monkey oranges. Like many climbing *Strychnos*, it has opposite leaves with three to five veins running from the base, and it may climb using hooked tendrils. Its fruits are round berries. Many *Strychnos* species contain poisonous alkaloids.
about.sw: *Strychnos panganensis* ni mtambaaji wenye miti au kichaka kinachotambaa, wa jenasi inayojumuisha mikwakwa. Kama *Strychnos* nyingi zinazopanda, ina majani yanayoelekeana yenye mishipa mitatu hadi mitano inayoanzia kwenye kitako, na huenda ikapanda kwa kutumia vikamba vilivyopinda kama ndoano. Matunda yake ni beri za mviringo. Spishi nyingi za *Strychnos* zina alkaloidi zenye sumu.
about.dg: *Strychnos panganensis* ni mmea wa nyama za muhi unaokpwera, au chitsaka chinachoambala, wa jenasi ambayo ina mihi ya *monkey orange*. Dza *Strychnos* nyinji zinazokpwera, makodzage ganalengana na gana mishipa mihahu hadi mitsano inayotuluka kula kotsi ya kodza, na unaweza kukpwera kpwa kuhumira vigongo vyembamba vyenye ntsa iriyomyoka. Matundage ni ga duara genye nyama. Aina nyinji za *Strychnos* zina kemikali za sumu (*alkaloids*).

where.en: It grows in the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ga Kenya na Tanzania.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chikwakwa*, writing the species as *Strychnos pangenesis*. The name looks like a small form of *mkwakwa*, the Swahili name for the black monkey orange (*mkpwakpwa* in Digo), which is in the same genus. Pakia doesn't explain the name, so that link is a guess.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chikwakwa*, akiiandika spishi hii kama *Strychnos pangenesis*. Jina hili linaonekana kuwa umbo dogo la *mkwakwa*, jina la Kiswahili la mkwakwa mweusi (black monkey orange; *mkpwakpwa* kwa Kidigo), ulio katika jenasi ile ile. Pakia haelezi jina hili, kwa hiyo uhusiano huo ni wa kukisia tu.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chikwakwa*, na anaandika aina ihi dza *Strychnos pangenesis*. Dzina rinaonekana dza *mkwakwa* mdide; *mkwakwa* ni dzina ra Chiswahili ra *black monkey orange* (kpwa Chidigo *mkpwakpwa*), ambao ni wa jenasi ihi ihi. Pakia kaeleza manage ga dzina hiri, kpwa hivyo uhusiano uho ni wa kukisiya tu.
